tha-ap126:1.1: Gandhodakiya.] Nisajja pāsādavare Vipassiṃ addasaṃ jinaṃ / kakudhaṃ vilasantaṃ va sabbaññūtam-anāsavaṃ. // //
tha-ap126:2.1: Pāsādassāvidūre ca gacchati lokanāyako / pabhā niddhāvate tassa sataraṃsimhi nibbute. // //
tha-ap126:3.1: Gandhodakañ ca paggayha Buddhaseṭṭhaṃ samokiriṃ / tena cittappasādena tattha kālakato ahaṃ. // //
tha-ap126:4.1: Ekanavute ito kappe yaṃ gandhodakaṃ samokiriṃ / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi Buddhapūjāy' idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap126:5.1: Ekatiṃse ito kappe Sugandho nāma khattiyo / sattaratanasampanno cakkavattī mahābalo. // //
tha-ap126:6.1: Paṭisambhidā catasso vimokhā pi ca aṭṭh' ime / chaḍabhiññā sacchikatā kataṃ Buddhassa sāsanan
tha-ap126:7.1: ti. // // Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Gandhodakiyo thero imā gāthāyo abhāsitthā ti.
